parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, providing access to the freezer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the freezer section, maintaining temperature control and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, providing access to the main cooling compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the refrigerator section, maintaining internal temperature and freshness.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Other (Dispenser Panel)
parts.Basic_description: This is the dispenser panel located on the refrigerator door, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the water and ice dispenser controls, allowing users to access chilled water or ice without opening the door.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed but includes small moving components like buttons or levers for dispensing.
